rows.grounds: instrumental plural indicating agents of obstruction
anaphoric pronoun referring to the person in question
gerundive expressing necessity or potentiality of being harmed
optative expressing a hypothetical or potential state
instrumental plural in simile indicating overpowering agents
compound denoting a young deer as the vulnerable subject of comparison

items.question: What fate befalls a person who is overwhelmed by all obstacles?
premises: A person can be subject to affliction by all obstacles.
Tigers overpower and afflict a helpless deer-calf.
The simile equates vulnerability to obstacles with a fawn's vulnerability to tigers.
items.inference: Without protective power, a person is utterly vulnerable to being afflicted by all obstacles.
uncertainties: The implicit contrast with the protected state described in the preceding verse is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: He would be afflicted by all obstacles, just as a deer-calf is afflicted by tigers.
